title: Nexova Telemetry Event Schemas
description: Draft-07 JSON Schemas for every telemetry event in the Nexova Telemetry Plan. Each event validates the standard Event Envelope plus an event-specific, allowlisted 'properties' object (additionalProperties: false everywhere, including inside 'properties', so nothing outside the documented allowlist can be emitted without a schema change).

envelope.description: Fields present on every event, regardless of event_type.

inbound_order_created.title: inbound_order_created
inbound_order_created.description: We need to know how much material is being produced/purchased, for which programme, and at what cost.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for this event instance.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

sessionId.description: Session the event belongs to. For system-emitted events, the triggering request's session if any, otherwise a synthetic job session id.

userId.description: Identifier of the authenticated user who performed the action.

requestId.description: Correlation id joining frontend, backend and logs for this action.

office.description: Office the transaction belongs to. Independent from interface language.

product_id.description: Stable identifier of the material item (product).

programme_id.description: Identifier of the training/certification programme the material belongs to.

currency.description: Local currency of the office. EUR for Valencia, USD for Miami. Never converted at the telemetry layer.

supplier_id.description: Identifier of the supplier the batch was received from.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the office's local currency, used for kit_cost_variance_detected.

order_id.description: Identifier of the InboundOrder record, for correlation with the inventory database.
